summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests paclitaxel given into the abdomen together with systemic therapy in people with gastrointestinal cancers that have spread to the lining of the abdomen, called peritoneal carcinomatosis. Paclitaxel is given into the abdomen and through a vein, either every 2 weeks or every 3 weeks, and the length of treatment is not stated. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; the stated aim is to assess feasibility, and the study is Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa paclitaxel administrado en la cavidad abdominal junto con terapia sistémica, en personas con cánceres gastrointestinales que se han diseminado al revestimiento del abdomen, llamado carcinomatosis peritoneal. El paclitaxel se administra dentro del abdomen y por vena, cada 2 semanas o cada 3 semanas; la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el objetivo indicado es evaluar la factibilidad, y el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Adenocarcinoma (cancer that starts in gland cells) of the digestive tract, confirmed by tissue or cell testing
Peritoneal carcinomatosis, shown by positive abdominal fluid cytology or by imaging, laparoscopy, or laparotomy
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 2 or less
Blood counts, liver, kidney, and albumin levels within the study limits
not_for: Bowel obstruction, except gastric outlet obstruction from the primary cancer
Uncontrolled illness, such as active infection, heart failure, or stroke or heart attack within 3 months
Another primary cancer within the last 3 years, with some skin and early-stage cancers excepted
Prior repeated intraperitoneal therapy (HIPEC, PIPAC, or NIPEC); a single HIPEC at surgery is not excluded
